title: Component Assembly Recipes
subtitle: Industrial Nexus support recipes for the Tech Wave
summary: The Tech starter now includes Component Assembler recipes for PowerGrid support components.
body: Use the Component Assembler to make photovoltaic arrays, biofuel turbines, ceramic insulators, and high-voltage buses before placing higher-tier PowerGrid blocks. These recipes give the 1.0.0 Tech Wave a clearer material bridge without adding a new machine tier.
